mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sub_task ( id, task_id, module_id, title, deliverable, acceptance, priority, status, assigned_agent_id, content, context, score_factors, composite_score, score_grade, deadline, rework_count, complete_time, version, timeout_count, external_fallback_count, reassign_attempt_count, depends_on, owner, lease_until, is_contract, required_skills, constraints, uncertainties, deleted, create_by, update_by, create_time, update_time, remark ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{taskId}, #{moduleId}, #{title}, #{deliverable}, #{acceptance}, COALESCE(#{priority}, 'MEDIUM'), COALESCE(#{status}, 'PENDING'), #{assignedAgentId}, #{content}, #{context,typeHandler=com.baomidou.mybatisplus.extension.handlers.JacksonTypeHandler}::jsonb, #{scoreFactors,typeHandler=com.baomidou.mybatisplus.extension.handlers.JacksonTypeHandler}::jsonb, #{compositeScore}, #{scoreGrade}, #{deadline}, COALESCE(#{reworkCount}, 0), #{completeTime}, COALESCE(#{version}, 0), COALESCE(#{timeoutCount}, 0), COALESCE(#{externalFallbackCount}, 0), COALESCE(#{reassignAttemptCount}, 0), COALESCE(#{dependsOn,typeHandler=com.baomidou.mybatisplus.extension.handlers.JacksonTypeHandler}::jsonb, '[]'::jsonb), #{owner}, #{leaseUntil}, COALESCE(#{isContract}, 0), COALESCE(#{requiredSkills,typeHandler=com.baomidou.mybatisplus.extension.handlers.JacksonTypeHandler}::jsonb, '[]'::jsonb), #{constraints}, COALESCE(#{uncertainties,typeHandler=com.helloai.core.task.entity.UncertaintyListTypeHandler}::jsonb, '[]'::jsonb), COALESCE(#{deleted}, 0), COALESCE(#{createBy}, ''), COALESCE(#{updateBy}, ''), COALESCE(#{createTime}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), COALESCE(#{updateTime}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), #{remark} )
mapper.update: UPDATE sub_task SET task_id = #{et.taskId}, module_id = #{et.moduleId}, title = #{et.title}, deliverable = #{et.deliverable}, acceptance = #{et.acceptance}, priority = #{et.priority}, status = #{et.status}, assigned_agent_id = #{et.assignedAgentId}, content = #{et.content}, context = #{et.context,typeHandler=com.baomidou.mybatisplus.extension.handlers.JacksonTypeHandler}::jsonb, score_factors = #{et.scoreFactors,typeHandler=com.baomidou.mybatisplus.extension.handlers.JacksonTypeHandler}::jsonb, composite_score = #{et.compositeScore}, score_grade = #{et.scoreGrade}, deadline = #{et.deadline}, rework_count = #{et.reworkCount}, depends_on = #{et.dependsOn,typeHandler=com.baomidou.mybatisplus.extension.handlers.JacksonTypeHandler}::jsonb, owner = #{et.owner}, lease_until = #{et.leaseUntil}, is_contract = COALESCE(#{et.isContract}, 0), required_skills = COALESCE(#{et.requiredSkills,typeHandler=com.baomidou.mybatisplus.extension.handlers.JacksonTypeHandler}::jsonb, '[]'::jsonb), constraints = #{et.constraints}, uncertainties = COALESCE(#{et.uncertainties,typeHandler=com.helloai.core.task.entity.UncertaintyListTypeHandler}::jsonb, '[]'::jsonb), complete_time = #{et.completeTime}, version = #{et.version}, timeout_count = #{et.timeoutCount}, external_fallback_count = #{et.externalFallbackCount}, reassign_attempt_count = #{et.reassignAttemptCount}, update_by = #{et.updateBy}, update_time = #{et.updateTime} WHERE id = #{et.id} AND version = #{MP_OPTLOCK_VERSION_ORIGINAL} AND deleted = 0

UPDATE sub_task SET assigned_agent_id = #{agentId}, status = 'ASSIGNED', version = version + 1, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{subTaskId} AND status = 'PENDING' AND (assigned_agent_id IS NULL OR assigned_agent_id = #{agentId}) AND deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sub_task WHERE assigned_agent_id = #{agentId} AND status IN ('ASSIGNED', 'IN_PROGRESS', 'REWORK') AND deleted = 0

SELECT st.id FROM sub_task st WHERE st.status = 'PENDING' AND st.create_time < #{cutoff} AND st.deleted = 0 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM agent_execution_record aer WHERE aer.sub_task_id = st.id ) ORDER BY /* N-006：优先级出队（HIGH=3/MEDIUM=2/LOW=1）+ aging（等待≥30min +1、≥60min +2，cap +2）防饿死 + 同档 FIFO */ (CASE st.priority WHEN 'HIGH' THEN 3 WHEN 'MEDIUM' THEN 2 WHEN 'LOW' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END + CASE WHEN st.create_time < (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '60 minutes') THEN 2 WHEN st.create_time < (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '30 minutes') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) DESC, st.create_time ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT st.id FROM sub_task st WHERE st.status = 'PENDING' AND st.assigned_agent_id IS NULL AND st.deleted = 0 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM agent_execution_record aer WHERE aer.sub_task_id = st.id ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM agent_execution_record aer2 WHERE aer2.sub_task_id = st.id AND aer2.status IN ('PENDING', 'RUNNING') ) ORDER BY /* N-006：优先级出队 + aging 防饿死 + 同档 FIFO（与 selectStalePendingWithoutExecutionRecord 同款排序） */ (CASE st.priority WHEN 'HIGH' THEN 3 WHEN 'MEDIUM' THEN 2 WHEN 'LOW' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END + CASE WHEN st.create_time < (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '60 minutes') THEN 2 WHEN st.create_time < (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '30 minutes') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) DESC, st.create_time ASC LIMIT #{limit}
